en_how: A WebGL shader stacks a dozen arches and halo rings at different depths, scaling each by 1/depth and painting far to near: outside each arch opening is a saturated wall that glows at the rim and darkens outward; camera depth advances with time, layers fade as the camera passes through, and every pixel gets per-frame hash grain; a small glowing orb leads the way in Canvas and a single short line closes the film.
